findings.description: _SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR raised 0.5 -> 0.9 but is STILL under-protective: gate-admitted near-floor macro-saddle witnesses at eta in [0.90, 0.97] breach the production accuracy contract. Measured over the class's own population (floor=0.9): p90(err)=3.70e-3 (3.7x over P90_TOL=1e-3) and max(err)=1.02e-2 (> OUTLIER_TOL=1e-2, at gamma=1.793 eta=0.9562). Only the eta=1.2868 witness passes. This is a production-reachable silent lnL bias (false-admit). The floor was derived as boundary(0.784)*1.15, but boundary was measured by scripts/measure_saddle_eta_floor.py against a 1e-4-rel-|F|-at-band-max metric over w in [8,60], which is NOT the production p90<=1e-3/max<=1e-2 contract over w in [8, W_CEILING_SCHWINGER] that the accuracy tests and the far-from-caustic certification enforce. The eta>=0.9 term does not bound the served zero-envelope error at the production bar in [0.9, ~1.0). INS-1-001/INS-2-001/INS-3-001 remain open.
findings.suggested_fix: Per the Professor asymmetry (false-admit unacceptable), either (a) raise _SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR further until the gate-admitted near-floor population satisfies p90<=1e-3 AND max<=1e-2 — empirically eta must exceed ~0.97 (likely ~1.0+), which begins eroding the transverse-cone win (audited real-use eta 1.0-2.5), so Professor must adjudicate the tension; OR (b) re-derive measure_saddle_eta_floor.py against the ACTUAL production p90<=1e-3/max<=1e-2 bar (not the 1e-4-at-band-max metric) and set the floor = that boundary * safety. Do not lower the floor. WP2 census mirror needs no change beyond the shared constant.

findings.description: The floor raise to 0.9 makes SaddleTier1EtaFloorNonRegressionTestCase.test_floor_still_below_inspector_flagged_edge fail deterministically: it asserts assertLess(_SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR, _INSPECTOR_FLAGGED_WORST_EDGE=0.784), i.e. assertLess(0.9, 0.784) -> AssertionError (confirmed by direct run: 1 failed, 1 passed, 22s). The suite ships RED. The governance test was written to 'flip to failing' when the floor clears 0.784, conflating 'clears the script edge' with 'resolves the breach' — but these are decoupled (see INS-4-001: floor cleared 0.784 yet the breach persists).
findings.suggested_fix: Reconcile this class and the frozen-anchor logic (L1810-1874) with the new floor so the suite is green. The 'below the inspector edge' invariant is now false and should be removed or re-expressed; keep only the monotone non-regression guard (floor may only rise, >= a frozen anchor). Coordinate the anchor value with the eventual INS-4-001 floor decision.

findings.description: SaddleTier1NearFloorEtaAccuracyTestCase.test_p90_within_production_tolerance and test_max_within_outlier_guard are still @expectedFailure and still xfail at floor=0.9 (ran: 4 passed, 2 xfailed), keeping the live near-floor production-accuracy breach GREEN so the commit gate cannot catch INS-4-001. INS-3-001 item-2 explicitly forbade shipping an @expectedFailure on a production-reachable accuracy claim ('the GATE moves, not the test'). The class docstring is also stale: 'Measured eta range [0.5035, 0.5339]', 'the 0.5 floor is under-protective', 'until a Coder raises _SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR past it' — floor is now 0.9 and the live measured range is [0.90, 1.29].
findings.suggested_fix: This is coupled to INS-4-001. Do NOT promote while they still fail. Once the floor is raised (or the bar re-derived) so the near-floor gate-admitted band genuinely meets p90<=1e-3 and max<=1e-2, remove the @expectedFailure decorators (Test Developer scope) and update the class/test docstrings to the corrected eta range and floor. Until then the breach must not be masked as a passing xfail — treat the floor as unfinished.

findings.description: The tracked measurement script still documents (L24-25) and PRINTS (L230) the WITHDRAWN rule '_SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR = min(0.5, boundary*2)'; the script's own output would announce a floor of 0.5 while the shipped constant is 0.9 — a direct spec/artifact inconsistency. Additionally the test file carries stale '(0.5)' annotations at L19 (`>= _SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR`` (0.5)`) and L973 (`eta < _SADDLE_ETA_FLOOR (0.5)`).
findings.suggested_fix: Update measure_saddle_eta_floor.py's docstring and printed rule to the shipped 'floor = boundary * safety (>=1.15), never capped below a measured-failing point' rule (and, per INS-4-001, ideally re-derive against the production p90/max bar). Fix the two '(0.5)' annotations in the test file to '(0.9)'.
